name: Cheatsheet translation check

# Every English cheatsheet under doc/cheatsheet/ must be fully translated into
# 繁體中文 in its i18n/zh/ overlay. A section with no entry does not fail the
# build — it silently falls back to English — so without this job the Chinese
# pages rot one edit at a time: by Sep 2026, 26 sheets carried 174 English
# sections and binary_search.zh.html showed 11 of its 66 in English, with every
# other check green.
#
# The rules live in `node script/zh.js check` rather than in a run: block, for
# the reason CLAUDE.md gives about site/e2e-check.js — so they can be run before
# pushing. Reproduce this job locally:
#
#   node --test site/test/i18n.test.js site/test/i18n.corpus.test.js
#   node script/zh.js check cheatsheet
#   node script/zh.js check behavioral
#
# To fix a failure: `node script/zh.js sync <id>` parks what an English edit
# invalidated, `node script/zh.js todo <id>` lists what is owed, or run
# `/lc-zh-translate <id>`. `/lc-cheatsheet` writes both languages in one pass.
#
# The FAQs are not gated here; `node script/zh.js check faq` passes today and
# can be run by hand.
#
# The two path lists are duplicated rather than shared through a YAML anchor:
# GitHub Actions does not resolve anchors.
on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
    paths:
      - 'doc/cheatsheet/**'
      - 'doc/behavioral/**'
      - 'i18n/**'
      - 'site/i18n.js'
      - 'script/zh.js'
      - 'site/test/i18n.test.js'
      - 'site/test/i18n.corpus.test.js'
      - '.github/workflows/zh-check.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]
    paths:
      - 'doc/cheatsheet/**'
      - 'doc/behavioral/**'
      - 'i18n/**'
      - 'site/i18n.js'
      - 'script/zh.js'
      - 'site/test/i18n.test.js'
      - 'site/test/i18n.corpus.test.js'
      - '.github/workflows/zh-check.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

# The job only reads the tree it checks out.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  zh-check:
    name: Cheatsheets fully translated
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Standard library only — site/i18n.js needs no npm install.
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      # The checker's own tests first: a shape rule that quietly stopped
      # matching would pass every document in the repo.
      - name: Test the checker
        run: node --test site/test/i18n.test.js site/test/i18n.corpus.test.js

      # Untranslated sections, orphaned entries, a dropped <!--CODE--> marker,
      # and a translated section whose table rows, list items, blockquotes,
      # links or images differ from its English.
      - name: Check every cheatsheet is fully translated
        run: node script/zh.js check cheatsheet

      # The behavioral guides are prose end to end, so an English edit that lands
      # without its Chinese leaves a visibly half-English page. Same gate.
      - name: Check every behavioral guide is fully translated
        run: node script/zh.js check behavioral

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
